result.finding: Multi-stage Dockerfile with 2 stages. Final image has approximately 8-10 layers: inherited base layers from eclipse-temurin:8-jre plus WORKDIR, COPY (from build stage), and ENV instructions. Build stage layers (4 RUN/COPY) are discarded.
evidence: 2 FROM instructions: build stage (maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-8) and final stage (eclipse-temurin:8-jre)
Build stage: 2 COPY + 2 RUN instructions (4 layers, discarded in final image)
Final stage: WORKDIR (1 layer), COPY --from=build (1 layer), ENV (1 layer)
eclipse-temurin:8-jre base contributes approximately 5-7 inherited layers
RUN instructions in build stage are combined effectively; no redundant update+install pairs
values: Estimated final image layer count: 8-10 layers
RUN instructions: 2 (both in build stage only)
COPY/ADD instructions: 3 total (2 in build stage, 1 final COPY --from=build)
